import { ButtonProps as ButtonProps$1, DialogProps, DialogTriggerProps, HeadingProps, MenuTriggerProps, ModalOverlayProps, PopoverProps as PopoverProps$1, SeparatorProps, TextProps, TooltipProps as TooltipProps$1, TooltipTriggerComponentProps } from "react-aria-components";
import { ComponentPropsWithRef, ReactElement, ReactNode, RefAttributes, RefCallback } from "react";
/** The visual treatment applied to a shared UI button. */
type ButtonVariant = 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'outline' | 'ghost' | 'destructive';
/** The named geometry scale applied to a shared UI button. */
type ButtonSize = 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
/** Props for the product-neutral shared UI button. */
type ButtonProps = ButtonProps$1 & RefAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & {
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  iconOnly?: boolean;
};
/** A semantic, accessible action button built on React Aria Components. */
export declare const Button: import("react").ForwardRefExoticComponent<Omit<ButtonProps, "ref"> & RefAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>>;
interface ActionMenuConfirmation {
  title: ReactNode;
  description: ReactNode;
  actionLabel: ReactNode;
  /** Invalidates an open confirmation when the reviewed operation changes. */
  guard?: ActionMenuConfirmationGuard;
}
interface ActionMenuConfirmationGuard {
  readonly fingerprint: string;
  readonly getFingerprint: () => string;
  readonly subscribe: (listener: () => void) => () => void;
}
type ActionMenuItemVariant = 'default' | 'destructive';
type ActionMenuProps = Pick<MenuTriggerProps, 'defaultOpen' | 'isOpen' | 'onOpenChange'> & {
  label: string;
  trigger?: ReactElement;
  children: ReactNode;
  portalContainer?: HTMLElement | null;
  layerBase?: number;
};
interface ActionMenuItemProps {
  label: string;
  icon?: ReactNode;
  onAction: () => void | Promise<void>;
  isDisabled?: boolean;
  variant?: ActionMenuItemVariant;
  confirmation?: ActionMenuConfirmation;
}
interface ActionSubmenuProps {
  label: string;
  icon?: ReactNode;
  isDisabled?: boolean;
  children: ReactNode;
}
type ActionMenuSeparatorProps = Omit<SeparatorProps, 'orientation'>;
export declare function ActionMenu({ label, trigger, children, portalContainer, layerBase, defaultOpen, isOpen, onOpenChange }: ActionMenuProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export declare function ActionMenuItem({ label, icon, onAction, isDisabled, variant, confirmation }: ActionMenuItemProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export declare function ActionSubmenu({ label, icon, isDisabled, children }: ActionSubmenuProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export declare function ActionMenuSeparator({ className, ...props }: ActionMenuSeparatorProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
/** Content positions accepted by the product-neutral DashHeader layout. */
interface DashHeaderSlots {
  leading?: ReactNode;
  title?: ReactNode;
  actions?: ReactNode;
  trailing?: ReactNode;
}
/** Props for the product-neutral DashHeader layout primitive. */
type DashHeaderProps = Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>, 'children'> & {
  slots: Readonly<DashHeaderSlots>;
};
/** Lays out caller-owned header content without adding product behavior or semantics. */
export declare const DashHeader: import("react").ForwardRefExoticComponent<Omit<DashHeaderProps, "ref"> & import("react").RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>;
/** Built-in color theme preferences. */
type PicodashTheme = 'light' | 'dark' | 'system';
/** Built-in preferences plus an application-declared custom theme name. */
type PicodashThemeOption<CustomTheme extends string = never> = PicodashTheme | (CustomTheme extends PicodashTheme | PicodashDensity ? never : CustomTheme);
/** A theme name after `system` has been resolved. */
type PicodashResolvedTheme<CustomTheme extends string = never> = 'light' | 'dark' | (CustomTheme extends PicodashTheme | PicodashDensity ? never : CustomTheme);
/** The independent presentation density axis. */
type PicodashDensity = 'regular' | 'compact';
interface PicodashThemeProviderProps<CustomTheme extends string = never> {
  children: ReactNode;
  theme?: PicodashThemeOption<NoInfer<CustomTheme>>;
  density?: PicodashDensity;
}
export declare function PicodashThemeProvider<CustomTheme extends string = never>({ children, theme, density }: PicodashThemeProviderProps<NoInfer<CustomTheme>>): ReactElement;
export declare function usePicodashTheme(): string;
export declare function usePicodashDensity(): PicodashDensity;
interface PicodashOverlayProviderProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  portalContainer?: HTMLElement | null;
  layerBase?: number;
}
interface PicodashOverlayDefaults {
  readonly portalContainer: HTMLElement | null;
  readonly layerBase?: number;
}
export declare function PicodashOverlayProvider({ children, portalContainer, layerBase }: PicodashOverlayProviderProps): ReactElement;
export declare function usePicodashOverlayDefaults(): Readonly<PicodashOverlayDefaults>;
type AlertDialogSize = 'default' | 'sm';
type AlertDialogProps = Omit<DialogTriggerProps, 'children'> & {
  children: ReactNode;
  isKeyboardDismissDisabled?: boolean;
};
type AlertDialogTriggerProps = Omit<ButtonProps, 'slot'>;
type AlertDialogOverlayProps = Omit<ModalOverlayProps, 'children' | 'defaultOpen' | 'isDismissable' | 'isKeyboardDismissDisabled' | 'isOpen' | 'onOpenChange' | 'shouldCloseOnInteractOutside' | 'UNSTABLE_portalContainer'> & {
  children: ReactNode;
  portalContainer?: HTMLElement | null;
  layerBase?: number;
};
type AlertDialogContentProps = Omit<DialogProps, 'aria-describedby' | 'aria-label' | 'aria-labelledby' | 'children' | 'role'> & {
  children: ReactNode;
  size?: AlertDialogSize;
};
type AlertDialogHeaderProps = ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>;
type AlertDialogFooterProps = ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>;
type AlertDialogMediaProps = ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>;
type AlertDialogTitleProps = Omit<HeadingProps, 'slot'>;
type AlertDialogDescriptionProps = Omit<TextProps, 'elementType' | 'slot'>;
type AlertDialogActionProps = Omit<ButtonProps, 'slot'> & {
  closeOnPress?: boolean;
};
type AlertDialogCancelProps = Omit<ButtonProps, 'slot'>;
export declare function AlertDialog({ children, isKeyboardDismissDisabled, ...props }: AlertDialogProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export declare const AlertDialogTrigger: import("react").ForwardRefExoticComponent<Omit<AlertDialogTriggerProps, "ref"> & import("react").RefAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>>;
export declare function AlertDialogOverlay({ children, portalContainer, layerBase, className, style, ...props }: AlertDialogOverlayProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export declare function AlertDialogContent({ children, size, ...props }: AlertDialogContentProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export declare const AlertDialogHeader: import("react").ForwardRefExoticComponent<Omit<import("react").DetailedHTMLProps<import("react").HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, HTMLDivElement>, "ref"> & import("react").RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>;
export declare const AlertDialogFooter: import("react").ForwardRefExoticComponent<Omit<import("react").DetailedHTMLProps<import("react").HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, HTMLDivElement>, "ref"> & import("react").RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>;
export declare const AlertDialogMedia: import("react").ForwardRefExoticComponent<Omit<import("react").DetailedHTMLProps<import("react").HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, HTMLDivElement>, "ref"> & import("react").RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>;
export declare function AlertDialogTitle({ className, ...props }: AlertDialogTitleProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export declare function AlertDialogDescription({ className, id: idProp, ...props }: AlertDialogDescriptionProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export declare const AlertDialogAction: import("react").ForwardRefExoticComponent<Omit<AlertDialogActionProps, "ref"> & import("react").RefAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>>;
export declare const AlertDialogCancel: import("react").ForwardRefExoticComponent<Omit<AlertDialogCancelProps, "ref"> & import("react").RefAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>>;
interface TooltipProviderProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  delay?: number;
  closeDelay?: number;
}
type TooltipProps = Pick<TooltipTriggerComponentProps, 'closeDelay' | 'defaultOpen' | 'delay' | 'isOpen' | 'onOpenChange'> & {
  children: ReactNode;
};
interface TooltipTriggerProps {
  children: ReactElement;
}
type TooltipContentProps = Omit<TooltipProps$1, 'children' | 'defaultOpen' | 'isEntering' | 'isExiting' | 'isOpen' | 'onOpenChange' | 'triggerRef' | 'UNSTABLE_portalContainer'> & RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & {
  children: ReactNode;
  portalContainer?: HTMLElement | null;
  layerBase?: number;
};
export declare function TooltipProvider({ children, delay, closeDelay }: TooltipProviderProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
/**
 * A wrapperless trigger slot. Tooltip consumes this element and gives it React Aria's
 * interaction props; rendering the slot on its own returns the supplied element unchanged.
 */
export declare function TooltipTrigger({ children }: TooltipTriggerProps): ReactElement;
export declare function Tooltip({ children, delay, closeDelay, isOpen, defaultOpen, onOpenChange }: TooltipProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export declare const TooltipContent: import("react").ForwardRefExoticComponent<Omit<TooltipContentProps, "ref"> & RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>;
type PopoverProps = Omit<PopoverProps$1, 'UNSTABLE_portalContainer'> & RefAttributes<HTMLElement> & {
  portalContainer?: HTMLElement | null;
  layerBase?: number;
  variant?: 'help';
};
export declare const Popover: import("react").ForwardRefExoticComponent<Omit<PopoverProps, "ref"> & RefAttributes<HTMLElement>>;
/** Attach to the actual vertical scrollport. All feedback stays local to its DOM. */
export declare function useScrollFade(): RefCallback<HTMLElement>;
export type { ActionMenuConfirmation, ActionMenuConfirmationGuard, ActionMenuItemProps, ActionMenuItemVariant, ActionMenuProps, ActionMenuSeparatorProps, ActionSubmenuProps, AlertDialogActionProps, AlertDialogCancelProps, AlertDialogContentProps, AlertDialogDescriptionProps, AlertDialogFooterProps, AlertDialogHeaderProps, AlertDialogMediaProps, AlertDialogOverlayProps, AlertDialogProps, AlertDialogSize, AlertDialogTitleProps, AlertDialogTriggerProps, ButtonProps, ButtonSize, ButtonVariant, DashHeaderProps, DashHeaderSlots, PicodashDensity, PicodashOverlayDefaults, PicodashOverlayProviderProps, PicodashResolvedTheme, PicodashTheme, PicodashThemeOption, PicodashThemeProviderProps, PopoverProps, TooltipContentProps, TooltipProps, TooltipProviderProps, TooltipTriggerProps };
